process_issues.description: Every Bash call failed before the command could run. The sandbox could not start: 'apply-seccomp: write /proc/self/setgroups (nested userns is capability-restricted; caller must provide CAP_SYS_ADMIN): Permission denied'. This hit `gh pr view 226`, `git diff --stat fde86d1e..HEAD` and `git rev-parse HEAD`, so the PR diff, file list, intent, review threads and head SHA could not be read, and the head-freshness check could not run. Reviewer subagents use the same sandboxed Bash and would have had no way to fetch the change, so no reviewer was spawned. PR #226 was NOT reviewed. Re-run once the runner allows nested user namespaces (or provides CAP_SYS_ADMIN to bubblewrap).
Stopped at gating (§2/§3): with no diff access, any reviewer finding would have been speculative. The run emitted 0 of 0 reviewers on purpose. This empty record is not a clean review.
